items.why: A real failure the machine missed: MaaEnd's own log (debug/2026-10-07-2.log lines 180-185, 09:30:08) has six 「选项 "AutoStockBuy…" 的类型已从 "checkbox" 变更为 "switch"，已重置为默认值」, so 自动囤货 bought by MaaEnd's defaults, not the owner's lists. The old code knew only the 「已丢弃保存值」 wording and booked the run silently (relay.log 10-07 09:53:11); since c1c80674 both wordings fail the 「新版本认得全部旧设置」 check and push.

Machine check #20 must agree with the game's own numbers. The run log (history/2026-10-07/endfield/MaaEnd-05-29-05.log) reads 当前理智 277 -> 117 around a double claim (折金票 68000, 160 sanity), then a half claim (34000, 80 sanity) and 「理智不足」: 37 left, the figure the collector's per-claim rule gives (4efee4f2; its comment names this day: 「10-07 277 -> 117 -> half claim, and the next day's first reading fits 37 left, not 0」). #20 still takes one run as the largest drop between readings (160) and wants 0, so it reports the correct 37 as wrong. Not fixed at 79da6cb5: reported as a relay bug. Fixed 2026-10-13 (daysim-R3): #20 now prices the claim after the last reading by its own payout (折金票 68000 = 160, 34000 = 80), independently of the collector.

The daily report's Endfield next banner must come from the version briefing (up since 2026-10-06 20:00, bulletin cid 2183; the sim serves the 10-08 recording ef-briefing-v1d6), not say 「官方未公告」 as the machine's report did this evening. Owner noticed it 10-08 13:12 (errors R22); his words not found in 报错台账.txt / 被指出.txt: 待核.
